title: pouteria duclitan
intro: Pouteria duclitan, commonly known as the Andiroba tree, is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest in South America. The health benefits of Pouteria duclitan include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds, skin conditions, and infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as a natural anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant, making it a potential remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Pouteria duclitan include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
